response.overview: A woman reports a violent assault and rape to the police. In shock, she insists she never saw her attacker’s face - only his trench coat. The investigation falls to young detective Elizabeth. The first lead surfaces when officers detain a man photographing a young girl in a park. He claims he’s preparing an erotic portrait series, but the explanation fails to satisfy. Without hard evidence, the police are forced to release him.  Soon another attack occurs. This time the victim remembers the vehicle: a luxury Mercedes. A far sharper clue than a coat. The search intensifies - and results arrive swiftly.
response.title: Le Violeur Impuni
